hostAssumptions: UInt64 arithmetic wraps modulo 2^64. Decrementing remaining from x to zero while incrementing result from zero returns x; audit overflow cannot affect control flow or output.
The scalar helper allocates no bump-heap storage.

The singleton ABI branch allocates at most 64 bytes for one UInt64 result array, including allocation metadata, capacity, length, and element storage. The non-singleton branch returns the input allocation unchanged.
